cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Assigned by Procedure
cards.instruction: Get someone to accept an unwanted responsibility by proving that the rules, rotation, or tradition make it theirs.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Congratulations on becoming club president. Here are the toilet keys. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I thought the caretaker cleaned them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. We voted to save that fee. The minutes assign closing and cleaning to the president.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I proposed that when you were president.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, and I cleaned them all year. Your first presidential duty is continuing your savings.

mechanism: A conducts a presidential handover and offers practical supply guidance while using B own recorded cost-saving rule to assign cleaning.
confusable: Unlike asking a favor of the new president, A proves cleaning is attached to the office by B previous motion.
comparison: Inherited club office duties differ from a temporary household bin swap.
seedUse: D173-b caretaker fee vote, minutes and former president service; S02-b offers a useful handover rather than declaring continued power.
